parsed.explanation: The dossier documents state-directed targeting of gay and bisexual men and trans women: police arbitrary detention, bribe extraction, and coerced informing under threat of prison. It also records forced anal examinations characterised as torture and persistent impunity for police ill-treatment. Article 120 is applied, with prosecutions documented through 2023, and there is no documented remedy, since LGBTI organisations cannot register and no anti-discrimination protection exists. Societal hostility is documented, and a 2024 bill to ban discussion of LGBTQ people was reported, though unverified. Visitor-facing items (border, documents, facilities, ward placement) are not addressed, so they are open questions rather than established exposures. Trans-specific violence figures are absent. The closest anchor is the 0.25 tier of sustained coercive police targeting with custody abuse, adjusted slightly lower for the explicit torture finding and the absence of any working recourse. Score sits in the high-to-severe boundary, not at the severe tier, because execution and mass custodial sweeps are not documented.
